contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VALEN [---]S PF AVG ; R/ RESTIT[-] TOR RE[--]

Silver coin. Siliqua of Valens (364-378), Restitutor Rei Publicae issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. A chip is detached but mended by the finder. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN [---]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding labarum and Victory on globe. Reverse inscription: RESTIT[-] TOR RE[--]. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight:…
